primary_recommendation: Preserve exact Kailh V2 geometry. First validate no-change Kailh/Lofree-family samples. If adding one broader MX-stem family, use a separate Choc V2 + MX-pattern solder footprint study and alternate Gateron plate-height variant; no generic universal enlarged-center footprint.
smallest_pcb_addition: Two Choc V1 positioning holes per key, preserving original center and contacts, but current XVX caps do not fit. Repeated local trace reroutes still needed.
feasible_mx_expansion: Four added holes per key at selected MX-pattern orientation; keep all existing Kailh drills. Rotation 180 has no foreign pad collisions in conservative screen and 1.3041 mm minimum web to current switch drills. Copper still conflicts at 86 key sites. Not a completed routed design.
do_not_claim: Kailh CPG1353D01D01-16 is the exact 50 gf Lofree Ghost SKU; this was not established
All switches sold as Gateron 2.0 or 3.0 share identical geometry
Marketing support for MX caps certifies whole V11 case or stabilizer fit
A clear LED window proves improved brightness with the ten-LED acrylic guide
This study is KiCad DRC, fabrication approval, physical test, or firmware validation
datum: Installed stem heights refer to PCB top to switch stem tip at rest and exclude below-board pins/posts. Numbers explicitly labeled derived were calculated from manufacturer dimension chains. Retail total-height numbers use differing datums.
cross_option_constraint: Choc V1 side pegs at +/-5.5 mm and MX side pegs at +/-5.08 mm are only 0.42 mm apart. Their separate 1.9 and 1.7 mm holes overlap; these are alternative expansion options, not holes to add together without a separate slot/retention study.

shared_locator_followup.conclusion: Different locating post spacing does not make Choc V1 and selected Gateron 3.0 switches mutually impossible on a shared PCB. A common shaped side opening can geometrically accommodate both reference patterns while preserving the original Choc V2 holes.
shared_locator_followup.qualification: Nominal geometric coverage checked only. Final peg fit, tolerances, plate variants, alternate electrical holes, routing and manufacturing rules still need validation.
shared_locator_followup.correction_to_previous_recommendation: Excluding Choc V1 solely because its separate round locator holes overlap Gateron 3.0 locator holes was too restrictive.

gateron_1_0_followup.note: Original Gateron low-profile reference shares the older KS-33 contact locations, but differs in center hole recommendation; generation name alone is insufficient for mechanical fit.
